description: Graded Pokémon and One Piece cards with live marketplace listings well under the SlabLineage price right now. For each card: the grade, the SlabLineage price, how many live deals SlabLineage shows, and its card page. The listings themselves are in SlabLineage's Ending Soon list (dealsPage). Up to 10 cards, most deals at the top.

grade.description: Limit to one grade, as text: "10" or "9".

maxSlPrice.description: Cards whose SlabLineage price is at most this many USD.

query.description: Card or set name to narrow the results, e.g. "charizard".

name: find_deals
title: Find deals
